messages:
Tara: Dropped a compact field-ready one-pager 'Roadshow Pocket Brief' \\u2014 1 page on SLAs, secure deploy modes, a tiny benchmark card, and suggested CTA. Link: https://docs.google.com/d/roadshow
Devon: Skimmed. Looks tight. Two tiny asks: 1) include a one-line graceful degradation sentence (fallbacks/canary), 2) give a microcopy option for a low-friction CTA.
Mika: I'll take inbound routing. Suggest auto-attach when form selects 'enterprise' OR checkbox 'SLAs required'. Mark 'on-prem' as high-touch and route to SE + Legal. Also add an SDR note template.
Tara: Benchmark idea (short): "p95 ~140ms for typical gen; hosted ~ $0.018 /1k tokens; reserved/dedicated can cut unit cost ~30-40% at steady utilization." Put it in the stat-card.
Devon: Webinar tie: use the brief as the post-webinar leave-behind and a single stat card image in the follow-up. Subject line A/B suggestions below.
Devon: ```
Subject A: Roadshow: Secure LLM serving for regulated teams
Subject B: Enterprise SLAs & secure deployments for LLMs
```
Mika: Inbound routing pseudocode (YAML-like):
```
routes:
  - when: form.fields.contains('SLAs required') OR lead.tags.includes('enterprise')
    action: attach('Roadshow-Pocket-Brief.pdf')
    assign: enterprise-field
    priority: P1
  - when: form.request.contains('on-prem') OR form.request.contains('air-gapped')
    action: assign(solutions-engineering); notify(legal@redwood.com)
  - else:
    action: assign(growth-sdr)
```
Mika: SDR note template: "Lead requires SLA discussion; attach Roadshow Pocket Brief; propose 30m scoping call with SEs."
Tara: CTA microcopy options:
- Primary (gated): "Download Roadshow Pocket Brief: SLAs & secure deployment checklist"
- Secondary (high-touch): "Request a secure deployment scoping call"
Devon: I'd keep the primary gated to capture intent. Button microcopy: "Download: Roadshow Pocket Brief (1 page)" keeps friction low.
Tara: Add the graceful degradation line: "Automatic model fallbacks and canary rollouts help preserve availability during updates or regional capacity events." Put that under the SLA bullets.
Mika: I'll push the routing to the inbound playbook and enable auto-attach. ETA tomorrow AM.
Devon: I'll add the benchmark + a 20s webinar talking point: "Many product teams trade off latency, cost, and compliance. Redwood's runtime lets you pin SLAs, choose VPC/on-prem networking, and use automated fallbacks to keep products live while optimizing unit cost." ETA 1pm.
Tara: I'll finalize microcopy and schedule social + webinar announcement once assets are uploaded. Target: finalize by Wed EOD. :rocket:
PO-Bot: Calendar event created: 'Roadshow Pocket Brief final review' Wed 10:00 AM  invite sent to Tara, Devon, Mika.
